task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick up the Coca-Cola soda can with the right arm, place into the yellow basket for carrying stuff, the other arm raises the yellow basket for carrying stuff.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，右臂拿起可口可乐汽水罐，放入黄色提物篮中，另一臂抬起黄色提物篮。
